name: Don Irish
description: Don Irish (also known simply as Don in Ireland) is a point-trick game for four players in fixed partnerships. It is a descendant of the 17th-century game All Fours and is closely related to Dom Pedro. The game focuses on capturing specific high-value scoring cards, particularly the 'Pedros' (fives) and the nines.

history.origins: Don is derived from the older game Dom Pedro, which was popular in Ireland and America in the 19th century. In Ireland, the name was shortened to 'Don'.
timeline: 1800s: Dom Pedro gains popularity in Ireland and the US.
Late 1800s: Irish players shorten the name to Don and refine the scoring to include higher values for Nines.
Modern Era: Remains a staple pub game in Ireland and is famously played in Irish correctional facilities.
history.cultural: Highly social and competitive, often played for 'legs' (games) in a match.
history.evolution: Irish Don is distinguished from the British 'Nine-Card Don' by its 13-card deal (using the full deck) and more aggressive scoring for the Nine of trumps.

setup.dealing: Dealer deals all 52 cards (13 to each player) in batches of 3 or 4.

rules.objective: Capture tricks containing scoring cards to reach a total of 121 points.
rules.gameplay:
1. Pitching: The player who leads the first card (the pitcher) determines the trump suit by the suit of the card they lead.
2. Trick-Taking: Players must follow suit if possible. In some variants (following All Fours), you may choose to trump even if you can follow suit.
3. Card Ranking: A (high) K, Q, J, 10, 9, 8, 7, 6, 5, 4, 3, 2.
keyRules: The 'Off-Five' (same color as trump) is considered part of the trump suit.
There is no score for 'Game' (the count of high cards) in the Irish version, unlike English Don.
Winning a match usually requires winning 3 or 5 'legs'.

strategy.basic: Prioritize capturing the Fives and Nines. A single trick containing a Nine and a Pedro is a massive 14ndpoint swing.
strategy.intermediate: If your partner leads a suit, 'smear' your high-value 5s onto the trick if you think mereka will win it, to ensure the points are safe.
strategy.advanced: Defensive Pitching: If you have a poor hand, pitch a suit where you have no scoring cards to minimize the points available to opponents.
tips: The Nine of trumps is the most iconic card in Irish Donâ€”protect it at all costs.
Remember that the 5 of Diamonds is a trump if Hearts are led.
